gateway_label: an LLM gateway with MCP features
install: pip litellm[proxy]==1.109.1 in its own venv (open-source build, no licence key, no database)

login_server.scope_cap: requested ∩ subject; subject's scope if none requested

client_transport: HTTPTransport (legacy Streamable HTTP); MCPClient asks for 2026-07-28, LiteLLM answers with its default set
upstream_protocol_version: 2025-11-25 (the upstream answers initialize with the requested legacy version; LiteLLM 1.109.1 advertises 2024-11-05..2025-11-25 by default)
caller_auth: x-litellm-api-key: throwaway master key; Authorization: Bearer <user JWT>
gateway_run_config:
# LiteLLM 1.109.1 config for the XID-10 gate. Loopback only; the driver
# (integration/xid10_litellm_gate.py) substitutes http://127.0.0.1:4580/mcp,
# http://127.0.0.1:4590/token, sha256:273f426206c4 and {{STATIC_TOKEN}} into a temp copy.
# The master key comes from the environment (a throwaway generated per run).
model_list: []
litellm_settings:
  telemetry: false
general_settings:
  master_key: os.environ/LITELLM_MASTER_KEY
mcp_servers:
  notes:
    url: http://127.0.0.1:4580/mcp
    transport: http
    auth_type: oauth2_token_exchange
    token_exchange_endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:4590/token
    client_id: litellm-gw
    client_secret: sha256:273f426206c4
    audience: https://upstream.test/mcp
    subject_token_type: urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:jwt
    token_exchange_profile: rfc8693
    scopes: ["read:notes"]
note: no cache: the cachescope probe has nothing to test, so it is not run (DOES NOT CACHE)
